LanguageData.HD_Settings_LimitToOnePlatoon_Desc: LOW raids field at most 40 people and HIGH raids at most 43. Excess raid budget is converted into support points.
LanguageData.HD_Settings_TacticalAI_Desc: Raiders use the squad tactical engine: stack-up room clearing, hand grenades, smoke, breaching charges and coordinated fire. It is unstable. When off, raiders use vanilla AI; engineers still breach doors and walls with sledgehammers and grenadiers still fire underbarrel grenade launchers, and raiders carry no hand grenades. Requires a restart.
